questions.question: Should the pull request for the blocking overlay change be merged to develop now? The unit, integration and UI test suites are all green on both runners, and the screenshots have been reviewed and look correct. The only open item is a mobile snapshot job that runs in the other repository and has not reported back yet. Do you want to merge now, wait for that job to finish, or hold the merge until Morgan decides?

options.label: Merge now
options.description: Merge the pull request to develop immediately, since every suite on both runners is green and the screenshots are reviewed. The blocking overlay change reaches develop right away and unblocks anyone waiting on it. If the mobile snapshot job later fails, a follow-up fix or revert would be needed.

options.label: Wait for the mobile job
options.description: Hold the merge until the mobile snapshot job in the other repository reports a result. This confirms the overlay change does not break mobile before it lands on develop. It delays the merge by however long that job takes and keeps the blocked work waiting.

options.label: Hold for Morgan to decide
options.description: Leave the pull request open and ask Morgan to make the call on merging. This puts the decision with the person who owns the risk tradeoff between speed and the unfinished mobile check. Nothing merges until Morgan responds.
